condition: type 2 diabetes with established cardiovascular disease
statistical_analysis_plan: Two-sided alpha of 0.05. Outcomes are tested in a fixed hierarchical sequence: the primary outcome is tested first, and secondary outcomes are formally tested only if the primary outcome reaches significance. No alpha adjustment is applied to secondary outcomes outside that sequence.

outcomes.measure: 3-point MACE (cardiovascular death, non-fatal MI, non-fatal stroke) at 104 weeks
change in HbA1c from baseline at 52 weeks (percentage points)
